# chalk_project (Data Source)

Reads a Chalk project by ID. Looks up the project in the authenticated team via TeamService.GetTeam.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Project identifier.

### Read-Only

- `git_repo` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `team_id` (String)
